meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 它会记录多智能体系统里每一次分发、扫描、解析、卡片生成等操作事件，按 trace_id 串成可追溯证据链，同时生成向量索引，并提供按条件检索历史证据的接口。
howto.when: 当你构建多智能体系统、需要全链路可观测或安全审计时，各官署会在分发、扫描、解析等关键操作节点调用它，或通过事件总线异步推送事件。

say.text: 把军机处这次派发事件写进证据链
say.note: 按 trace_id 串联并落地为事件记录

say.text: 按 trace_id 检索这条链路的全部历史证据
say.note: 返回证据链与对应向量索引条目

say.text: 查最近时间窗内的官署执行事件
say.note: 检索超时会返回上次快照并标 stale

howto.what_en: It records each dispatch, scan, parse, and card-generation event, chains them by trace_id into a traceable evidence chain, builds a vector index, and exposes a query API for searching past evidence.
howto.when_en: Use when building multi-agent systems that need end-to-end observability or security audit: called at key operation nodes, or fed events asynchronously via the event bus.

say_en.text: Write this dispatch event into the evidence chain
say_en.note: Chains it by trace_id and stores the event

say_en.text: Retrieve all evidence for this trace_id
say_en.note: Returns the evidence chain and vector index entries

say_en.text: Query officer events in the last time window
say_en.note: On timeout returns the last snapshot marked stale
